answer: The grove test I would run is Proof of unique charity shop volunteer record with charity retailer attestation: shifts the retailer recorded across years of shops, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since shifts the retailer recorded across years of shops takes calendar time as well as money — and the hollow is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The haven grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
